$comment: Advisories that npm audit reports against an installed version but that cannot reach this
codebase. Checked by scripts/check_js_audit.py in the `Dependency audit` job; see ADR-0017.
An entry is a written, dated argument, not a mute button: the build fails on any advisory
with no entry, on any entry past its review_by, and on any entry that matches nothing in
today's report. Every field is required, and unknown fields are refused.
Empty is the good state, and it is not the same as absent: the file has to exist and parse,
and an empty list means every advisory in today's report has to be zero. GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2
(react-router CSRF in RSC Mode) lived here from 27/07 to 24/08/2026 and was removed when
react-router 7.18.2 fixed it on the 7.x line - the entry then matched nothing, and the gate
failed on that, which is exactly what it is for. See ADR-0017 and docs/adr history.
